name: Awadhi
caution: 0.4 million words, versus hundreds of millions for the main languages. Frequency values are unreliable, so there are no frequency bands, only the all-words generators. The reference lexicon has 21,216 words, so generators, neighbourhood measures and cluster filters are rougher than for the main languages. Little Awadhi text is openly available. The word list comes from about 390,000 words: modern prose (K.M. Institute corpus), the Awadhi Wikipedia and a few websites, and Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas, a 16th-century poem whose vocabulary and spellings differ from today's Awadhi. Everyday spoken Awadhi is under-represented and spelling is not standardised, so have a speaker check your items. Speakers of Awadhi also know Hindi, and the two share much vocabulary. Every word form of Hindi (80,074 forms) was added to the reject list, so no pseudoword is a real Hindi word, and the app pre-selects Hindi under "Exclude real words of other languages" (the Word-in column shows near misses). Of the 21,216 reference words, 8,800 are also Hindi words; they stay in the lexicon because they are words of both languages. Awadhi (Devanagari) is an abugida: CV (orthographic) counts every consonant letter as C plus an inherent vowel V unless a vowel sign or virama follows. CV (phonological) applies the Hindi-type schwa-deletion rule (not checked against pronunciations). Length is counted in aksharas.

source: HPLT 3.0 web text word list awa_hplt (CC0; Oepen et al. 2025)

english_contamination_removed.rule: Leipzig-only words of 5+ letters that are English words with Zipf >= 4.5

reference_lexicon: plain words (alphabet only) with Zipf >= 2.0 and corpus count >= 3

model.trigram_variants: plain maximum-likelihood letter trigrams with two start markers and one end marker; type counts (each word once) or token counts (each word weighted by its per-million frequency)

filters.not_a_corpus_form: rejected if it occurs anywhere in the corpus word list
filters.phonotactic_legality: initial, medial and final consonant clusters and vowel sequences must each occur in >= 3 reference words

metrics.old20: mean Levenshtein distance to the 20 closest reference words
metrics.logprob: mean log2 probability per letter (incl. word end); model = generating model, all = all-words model

generation.target_rule: per generator and training set: 2 x the number of training words, between 5000 and 100000; a generator stops early when fewer than 1 in 20 recent samples is new and legal

uncased_names.rule: word romanised and matched with a name found capitalised-only in at least 12 other corpora (translit.py)

realword_filter.rule: a bank item is dropped if a Hunspell dictionary (affixes on, compounding off, lower-case or capitalised) accepts it, if it is a UniMorph lemma or form, or if it occurs (in lower case, in cased scripts) in a Bible translation
